text: minervini: "RS rank under 70 and a flat MA stack." Relative rank is not my test. Mine is whether the Creek broke on a wide bar, with volume, closing near the high, and whether price holds outside the old range (C4, C5). BALL passed all three on day_vol 1.9 and sits at the test, the C7 entry. A flat stack is what a range looks like just as it resolves. Your point stays as my against-case: value is not stepping up yet. I drop support on a daily close under bar_low 65.07 or back inside value under pvp_vah 64.66 (C11), which would be a failed breakout.
